ValidationRule.description: First Name, Address and Industry fields required when converting the lead #34927: Remove requirement for 'Industry' when Lead is converted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Lead',RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IMLA_Lead',RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IMAP_Lead'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Converted'),IsConverted), OR( ISBLANK( FirstName ), ISBLANK(Street), ISBLANK(City), ISBLANK(State), ISBLANK(Country), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Lead' , ISBLANK(PostalCode)) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Name and Address are required to Convert this Lead.
